protocol.preprocessing: LogHeavy -> ChannelScaler -> clip(+-10), fitted on train windows only (study make_data)
protocol.split_rule: per class sorted by severity: k%5==0 test, k%5==1 val, else train
protocol.training: class-weighted CE, Adam lr 1e-3, batch 64, max 100 epochs, patience 12, early stop on val macro-F1, best weights restored (study e5_train_torch recipe)
protocol.test_scoring: argmax of seed-mean probabilities (study E5 convention); macro-F1 over 12 labels, zero_division=0
